Suitable for business analysis reports, market research, operational reviews, strategic recommendations, and other **general consulting** scenarios. Emphasizes structured information presentation and data visualization; clean, clear, and professional style.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Consultant-specific Data Visualization Techniques
14	
15	### 1. KPI Dashboard Design
16	
17	KPI cards are the most common element in consulting reports. Standard layout (1280x720):
18	
19	```
20	4-card layout: each card 280x180, gap 30
21	  Card 1: x=45,  y=160
22	  Card 2: x=355, y=160
23	  Card 3: x=665, y=160
24	  Card 4: x=975, y=160
25	```
26	
27	**Card internal structure** (top to bottom):
28	
29	| Area | Content | Font Size | Style |
30	|------|---------|-----------|-------|
31	| Icon row | data-icon icon | 32x32 | Theme color |
32	| Metric name | "Monthly Active Users" | 14px | Gray #64748B |
33	| Core number | "1.2M" | 36-42px | Bold, dark color |
34	| Trend annotation | "+12.3% vs last month" | 12px | Green=up / Red=down |
35	
36	**Trend arrow conventions**:
37	- Up: `arrow-trend-up` icon + green text
38	- Down: `arrow-trend-down` icon + red text
39	- Flat: horizontal line icon + gray text
40	
41	### 2. Chart Color Conventions
42	
43	Consulting-style charts use **monochromatic depth gradients** rather than rainbow colors:
44	
45	```
46	Primary series:   Theme color 100% opacity
47	Comparison series: Theme color 60% opacity
48	Baseline:         #94A3B8 (gray dashed line)
49	Highlight:        Accent color (only for key data points)
50	```
51	
52	### 3. Data Annotation Principles
53	
54	- **Direct data labels**: Place values at the top of bar charts — no legend needed
55	- **Annotated trend lines**: Add text notes at key inflection points ("Policy change", "Product launch")
56	- **Comparison baselines**: Mark industry average / target values with gray dashed lines
57	- **Consistent units**: Maintain the same numeric units and precision within a chart
58	
59	### 4. Table Design
60	
61	Consulting reports frequently use tables for precise data:
62	
63	| Design Element | Specification |
64	|----------------|---------------|
65	| Header | Dark background + white text, font-weight="bold" |
66	| Zebra striping | Alternate rows with `fill-opacity="0.05"` light background |
67	| Number alignment | Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned |
68	| Highlighted row | Mark key rows with accent color `fill-opacity="0.1"` |
69	| Borders | Use horizontal lines only to separate rows; avoid full grid lines |
70	
71	---
72	
73	## Consulting-specific Layout Patterns
74	
75	### MECE Decomposition Tree
76	
77	Main trunk on the left, branches expanding rightward — mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive:
78	
79	```
80	Main metric ──┬── Branch A (45%)
81	              ├── Branch B (30%)
82	              ├── Branch C (20%)
83	              └── Branch D (5%)
84	```
85	
86	- Use `<line>` to connect trunk to branches
87	- Each branch has a `<rect>` container + percentage annotation
88	- Sum must = 100% (or explicitly label "Other")
89	
90	### Driver Factor Tree
91	
92	Top-level metric → decomposed factors → actions. Ideal for performance attribution analysis:
93	
94	```
95	Revenue growth 15%
96	  ├── Average order value +8%  → Premium product line expansion
97	  ├── Customer count +5%       → New channel acquisition
98	  └── Repurchase rate +2%      → Loyalty program optimization
99	```
100	
101	### Left-chart Right-text (Chart Interpretation)
102	
103	Core consulting report layout: chart on the left, key insights on the right:
104	
105	```
106	Chart area: x=40, y=120, w=700, h=480
107	Insight area: x=780, y=120, w=460, h=480
108	  - Core conclusion (bold, 16px)
109	  - 3-5 bullet points (14px)
110	  - Data source (12px, gray)
111	```
112	
113	---
114	
115	## Professional Expression Standards
116	
117	### Page Titles
118	
119	Consulting-style page titles should be **assertion headlines**, not descriptive titles:
120	
121	| Type | Descriptive (avoid) | Assertion (recommended) |
122	|------|---------------------|------------------------|
123	| Market | "Market Overview" | "Domestic market grows 23% YoY, significantly outpacing global average" |
124	| Competition | "Competitive Analysis" | "Three major competitors show clear weaknesses in channel coverage" |
125	| Finance | "Financial Data" | "Gross margin improved for four consecutive quarters, breaking industry ceiling" |
126	
127	### Data Source Attribution
128	
129	Every data-containing page must include a source note at the bottom:
130	
131	```xml
132	<text x="40" y="700" font-size="10" fill="#94A3B8">
133	  Source: National Bureau of Statistics 2025 Annual Report; Internal team analysis
134	</text>
135	```
136	
137	### Key Takeaway Box
138	
139	Consulting-style content pages should include a **Takeaway Box** below the title:
140	
141	```
142	Position: x=40, y=80, w=1200, h=50
143	Background: Light theme color (fill-opacity="0.08")
144	Text: 14-16px, one-sentence summary of the page's core takeaway
145	```
146	
147	---
148	
149	## Speaker Notes Style
150	
151	### Narrative Tone
152	
153	Consultant-style speaker notes use a **conclusion-driven** approach — state the conclusion first, then present supporting evidence. Professional, concise, and persuasive tone.
154	
155	### Stage Direction Markers
156	
157	| Marker | Purpose | Example |
158	|--------|---------|---------|
159	| `[Pause]` | Silence after key conclusions, let the audience absorb | "This means our market share is being eroded. [Pause]" |
160	| `[Data]` | Cue to verbalize numbers conversationally | "[Data] 85% → more than eight out of ten customers reported this issue" |
161	| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, must be at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Based on that analysis, let's look at specific recommendations." |
162	
163	### Notes Writing Guidelines
164	
165	- **Conclusion first**: The first sentence of each page's notes is the core takeaway
166	- **Conversational data**: 30% → "roughly one-third", 85% → "more than eight out of ten", 2.5x → "two and a half times"
167	- **Evidence follows immediately**: After the conclusion, provide 2-3 supporting data points/facts
168	- **Professional terminology**: Use terms like "insight", "driver", "key lever" etc.
169	- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core conclusion (2) Supporting data (3) Next steps`
170	
171	### Notes Example
172	
173	```markdown
174	# 03_key_findings
175	
176	[Transition] Based on our market scan, we have distilled three key findings.
177	
178	First, the primary growth driver is shifting from acquisition to retention.
179	[Data] New customer acquisition cost rose nearly 40% year-over-year, yet improved repurchase rates contributed over 60% of revenue growth. [Pause]
180	
181	Second, lower-tier market growth significantly outpaces tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
182	Third, the 25-35 female user segment has an ARPU 1.8x the overall average.
183	
184	Key points: (1) Growth engine shifting from acquisition to retention (2) Lower-tier market opportunity window (3) High-value user persona
185	Duration: 2 minutes
186	```
187	
188	---
189	
190	## Self-check Supplement (Consultant-specific)
191	
192	- [ ] Data matches source data — no fabrication
193	- [ ] Every data page has a source attribution at the bottom
194	- [ ] Page titles are assertion-based, not descriptive
195	- [ ] KPI cards have trend arrows and comparison annotations
196	- [ ] Chart colors are unified, using monochromatic scheme rather than rainbow
197	- [ ] Notes are conclusion-first with conversational data

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    KPI 卡片模板 - 2×2 布局（CRAP 优化版）
    用途: 展示关键业绩指标
    适用场景: 财务指标、业务数据看板、增长率展示
    优化: 强化对齐、对比、重复、亲密性原则
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片阴影 - 更精致柔和 -->
        <filter id="cardShadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="6"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="3" result="offsetblur"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.15"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
        
        <!-- 渐变背景 - 增加层次感 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#F8F9FA;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#ECF0F1;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 标题区域 - 增强对比 -->
    <text x="60" y="75" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="36" font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-0.5">
        <tspan>关键业绩指标</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="16" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>Key Performance Indicators</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- KPI 卡片布局 2×2 - 统一间距 40px -->
    
    <!-- 卡片 1 - 左上 (收入增长) -->
    <g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
        <!-- 卡片背景 - 更圆润的圆角 -->
        <rect x="60" y="150" width="560" height="250" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- 左侧色块指示器 - 更粗更醒目 -->
        <rect x="76" y="170" width="8" height="70" rx="4" fill="#2196F3"/>
        
        <!-- 指标名称 - 统一左边距 100px -->
        <text x="100" y="190" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368" letter-spacing="0.2">
            <tspan>总收入</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="100" y="213" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>Total Revenue</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 主数值 - 增强视觉权重 -->
        <text x="100" y="285" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="64" font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-1">

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    分组柱状图模板
    用途: 多系列数据对比
    适用场景: 多产品/时期/分类对比、同比环比分析
    支持: 4组 × 3系列（可调整为3-6组，2-4系列）
    与普通柱状图区别: 每个类别下有多个并排柱子，用于对比
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 系列1渐变（蓝色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列2渐变（绿色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列3渐变（橙色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="groupShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.25"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各季度产品线销售对比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年度 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(900, 70)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#groupGrad1)"/>
        <text x="30" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>产品线A</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="120" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#groupGrad2)"/>
        <text x="150" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>产品线B</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="240" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#groupGrad3)"/>
        <text x="270" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>产品线C</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- Y轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="570" x2="1180" y2="570" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="480" x2="1180" y2="480" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="390" x2="1180" y2="390" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="300" x2="1180" y2="300" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="210" x2="1180" y2="210" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="575" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>0</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="485" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>50</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="395" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>100</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="305" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>150</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="215" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>200</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 坐标轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="165" x2="140" y2="570" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="570" x2="1180" y2="570" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 
        分组说明：
        - 4个组（Q1-Q4），每组3个柱子
        - 组宽度：240px，组间距：20px
        - 柱宽：60px，柱间距：10px
        - 每组起始：170, 430, 690, 950
        - 每50单位=90px高度
        -->
        
        <!-- Q1 组 -->
        <!-- Q1 产品线A: 120M (高度216px) -->
        <rect x="170" y="354" width="60" height="216" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="200" y="342" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>120</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q1 产品线B: 85M (高度153px) -->
        <rect x="240" y="417" width="60" height="153" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="270" y="405" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>85</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q1 产品线C: 65M (高度117px) -->
        <rect x="310" y="453" width="60" height="117" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="340" y="441" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>65</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q1 标签 -->
        <text x="255" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q1</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 组 -->
        <!-- Q2 产品线A: 145M (高度261px) -->
        <rect x="430" y="309" width="60" height="261" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="460" y="297" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>145</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 产品线B: 98M (高度176px) -->
        <rect x="500" y="394" width="60" height="176" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="530" y="382" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>98</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 产品线C: 78M (高度140px) -->
        <rect x="570" y="430" width="60" height="140" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="600" y="418" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>78</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 标签 -->
        <text x="515" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q2</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 组 -->
        <!-- Q3 产品线A: 168M (高度302px) -->
        <rect x="690" y="268" width="60" height="302" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="720" y="256" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>168</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 产品线B: 112M (高度202px) -->
        <rect x="760" y="368" width="60" height="202" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="790" y="356" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>112</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 产品线C: 92M (高度166px) -->
        <rect x="830" y="404" width="60" height="166" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="860" y="392" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>92</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 标签 -->
        <text x="775" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q3</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 组 -->
        <!-- Q4 产品线A: 185M (高度333px) -->
        <rect x="950" y="237" width="60" height="333" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="980" y="225" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>185</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 产品线B: 125M (高度225px) -->
        <rect x="1020" y="345" width="60" height="225" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="1050" y="333" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>125</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 产品线C: 108M (高度194px) -->
        <rect x="1090" y="376" width="60" height="194" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="1120" y="364" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>108</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 标签 -->
        <text x="1035" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q4</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 趋势总结卡片 -->
    <g id="summaryCard">
        <rect x="60" y="630" width="400" height="60" rx="8" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="80" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>年度总计:</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="160" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2196F3">
            <tspan>618M</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="220" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>|</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="240" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#4CAF50">
            <tspan>420M</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="300" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>|</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="320" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#FF9800">
            <tspan>343M</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <text x="80" y="675" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="13" fill="#95A5A6">
            <tspan>同比增长: +15.2%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="1220" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6" text-anchor="end">
        <tspan>数据来源: 销售部门</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    分组柱状图模板
    用途: 多系列数据对比
    适用场景: 多产品/时期/分类对比、同比环比分析
    支持: 4组 × 3系列（可调整为3-6组，2-4系列）
    与普通柱状图区别: 每个类别下有多个并排柱子，用于对比
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 系列1渐变（蓝色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列2渐变（绿色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列3渐变（橙色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="groupShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.25"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各季度产品线销售对比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年度 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(900, 70)">

              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">

  </text>
  <line x1="500" y1="80" x2="780" y2="80" stroke="#D4AF37" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Takeaway 1 -->
  <rect x="80" y="105" width="1120" height="72" fill="#1F2937" rx="8"/>
  <rect x="80" y="105" width="4" height="72" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="100" y="122" width="32" height="32" fill="#1565C0"/>
  <text x="145" y="132" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Page weight keeps climbing</text>
  <text x="145" y="155" fill="#9CA3AF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13">Median desktop pages now transfer ~2,000 KB — roughly 25% heavier than in 2020, driven by richer media and JavaScript.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 2 -->
  <rect x="80" y="195" width="1120" height="72" fill="#1F2937" rx="8"/>
  <rect x="80" y="195" width="4" height="72" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="100" y="212" width="32" height="32" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <text x="145" y="222" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">HTTPS is the new baseline</text>
  <text x="145" y="245" fill="#9CA3AF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13">At 99%+ of requests, unencrypted HTTP is essentially extinct on the modern web. Desktop: 99.2%, Mobile: 99.1%.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 3 -->
  <rect x="80" y="285" width="1120" height="72" fill="#1F2937" rx="8"/>
  <rect x="80" y="285" width="4" height="72" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="100" y="302" width="32" height="32" fill="#7C3AED"/>
  <text x="145" y="312" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">HTTP/3 is the fastest-growing protocol metric</text>
  <text x="145" y="335" fill="#9CA3AF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13">From near-zero to ~40% support in under four years, HTTP/3 is rapidly becoming mainstream. Desktop: 38.7%, Mobile: 40.0%.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 4 -->
  <rect x="80" y="375" width="1120" height="72" fill="#1F2937" rx="8"/>
  <rect x="80" y="375" width="4" height="72" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="100" y="392" width="32" height="32" fill="#E65100"/>
  <text x="145" y="402" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Fewer TCP connections despite more requests</text>
  <text x="145" y="425" fill="#9CA3AF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13">Multiplexing in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 has cut median connections per page by 15–27%, improving network efficiency.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 5 -->
  <rect x="80" y="465" width="1120" height="72" fill="#1F2937" rx="8"/>
  <rect x="80" y="465" width="4" height="72" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="100" y="482" width="32" height="32" fill="#C62828"/>
  <text x="145" y="492" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Font-display still underused</text>
  <text x="145" y="515" fill="#9CA3AF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13">At ~40–42% adoption, there is significant room for improvement. Over half of pages still risk Flash of Invisible Text.</text>

  <!-- Call to Action -->
  <rect x="200" y="570" width="880" height="64" fill="#D4AF37" fill-opacity="0.12" rx="8" stroke="#D4AF37" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="640" y="600" text-anchor="middle" fill="#D4AF37" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="1">
    Benchmark your sites against these baselines
  </text>
  <text x="640" y="622" text-anchor="middle" fill="#9CA3AF" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14">
    httparchive.org/reports/state-of-the-web
  </text>

  <!-- Bottom -->
  <line x1="120" y1="660" x2="1160" y2="660" stroke="#1F2937" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="640" y="690" text-anchor="middle" fill="#D4AF37" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" letter-spacing="2">CONFIDENTIAL · HTTP Archive · May 2026</text>
</svg>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

Welcome to the State of the Web 2020 through 2025. This presentation draws exclusively from HTTP Archive crawl data covering January 2020 through March 2026. We'll examine five macro-level trends: page weight growth, HTTPS adoption, protocol shifts, TCP connection efficiency, and font-display CSS adoption. Each metric is measured separately for desktop and mobile.

Key points: ① HTTP Archive as the single data source ② Six-year observation window ③ Desktop and mobile measured separately
Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_sample_size

[Transition] Before diving into the metrics, let's understand the scale of the data itself.

The HTTP Archive crawl sample has grown dramatically. Desktop URLs went from roughly 5 million in January 2020 to about 16 million today — a 220% increase. Mobile URLs grew from 3.5 million to 12.5 million, a 257% increase. [Pause] The most notable feature of this chart is the sharp jump around mid-2022, when both lines leap upward before stabilizing into a plateau from mid-2023 onward. This larger sample gives us more representative and reliable trend data.

Key points: ① Desktop: 5M → 16M URLs (+220%) ② Mobile: 3.5M → 12.5M URLs (+257%) ③ Sharp mid-2022 jump, plateau since mid-2023
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_page_weight

[Transition] Now let's look at what those pages actually weigh.

Median desktop page weight has climbed from roughly 1,600 KB to 2,000 KB over the observation period — a 25% increase. Mobile pages track slightly lower at about 1,900 KB median but follow the same upward trajectory. [Data] The shaded bands represent the interquartile range, and you can see that the 75th percentile desktop page exceeds 4,000 KB — that's a long tail of very heavy pages. This growth is driven primarily by richer media and JavaScript payloads.

Key points: ① Desktop median: ~1,600 → ~2,000 KB (+25%) ② Mobile median: ~1,900 KB (+25%) ③ 75th percentile exceeds 4,000 KB on desktop
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_requests_connections

[Transition] While pages are getting heavier, there's an interesting efficiency story in how they're delivered.

On the left you see request counts: 76 per desktop page and 71 per mobile page, each up about 3% since 2020. But on the right, the story reverses — TCP connections per page are declining. Desktop dropped from about 15 connections to 12, a 14.3% reduction. Mobile went from 15 to 11, a 26.7% reduction. [Pause] The driver here is multiplexing. HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 allow many requests to flow over a single connection, so even as pages request more resources, they need fewer connections to do it.

Key points: ① Requests up ~3% on both platforms ② Desktop TCP: 15 → 12 (-14.3%) ③ Mobile TCP: 15 → 11 (-26.7%) ④ Multiplexing is the efficiency driver
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 05_https

[Transition] Perhaps the most dramatic shift of all is in encryption adoption.

99.2% of desktop requests and 99.1% of mobile requests now use HTTPS. That's up from roughly 80% in early 2020 — a 19 to 20 percentage point increase. [Data] The chart on the right shows the steady climb. In practical terms, plaintext HTTP is effectively extinct. If your site isn't on HTTPS, you're in the less-than-one-percent minority, and browsers will actively warn users about it.

Key points: ① 99.2% desktop, 99.1% mobile HTTPS ② Up ~19–20 pp from ~80% in 2020 ③ Plaintext HTTP is effectively extinct
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_protocol_adoption

[Transition] While HTTPS won the encryption story, the protocol story is more nuanced.

HTTP/2 holds steady at about 58–59% of requests — desktop at 58.6%, mobile at 57.6%. Growth has been modest, just 1 to 3%, partly because HTTP/3 is absorbing newer adoption. [Data] And HTTP/3's rise has been explosive — from near-zero in 2020 to 38.7% desktop support and 40% mobile support today. The percentage increases from baseline are enormous because the starting point was essentially zero. One caveat: HTTP Archive measures HTTP/3 support rather than actual usage, because fresh Chrome instances default to HTTP/2 before discovering HTTP/3 capability via Alt-Svc headers.

Key points: ① HTTP/2: ~58% flat, modest growth ② HTTP/3: near-zero → ~39–40% support ③ Measurement caveat: support vs. actual usage ④ HTTP/3 is the fastest-growing protocol metric
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_font_display

[Transition] Finally, let's look at a CSS best practice that's still far from universal.

The font-display property helps avoid the Flash of Invisible Text during web font loading. Desktop adoption is at 40.1%, up 14.9% since 2020. Mobile is at 42.5%, up 61% since 2020. [Pause] But here's the concern: more than half of all pages still don't use font-display, meaning users may experience invisible text while fonts load. This is a low-effort, high-impact optimization — a single CSS declaration can eliminate FOIT entirely.

Key points: ① Desktop: 40.1% adoption (+14.9%) ② Mobile: 42.5% adoption (+61.0%) ③ >50% of pages still risk FOIT ④ Low-effort, high-impact fix
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_key_takeaways

[Transition] Let me synthesize the five major findings from this data.

First, page weight keeps climbing — median desktop pages are 25% heavier than in 2020. Second, HTTPS is the new baseline at 99%+ of requests. Third, HTTP/3 is the fastest-growing protocol metric, surging from near-zero to about 40% support. Fourth, multiplexing has cut TCP connections by 15 to 27% despite more requests per page. And fifth, font-display is still underused at only 40 to 42% adoption — a clear optimization opportunity. [Pause] I encourage you to benchmark your own sites against these baselines at httparchive.org/reports/state-of-the-web.

Key points: ① Page weight +25% ② HTTPS at 99%+ ③ HTTP/3 surging to ~40% ④ TCP connections down 15–27% ⑤ Font-display still under 50% — fix it
Duration: 2 minutes

steps.message:
The presentation has been created and saved to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx` (76 KB, 8 slides).

**Summary of what was built:**
- **8-slide, 16:9 PPTX** using the Exhibit template (dark cover + white content pages with gold accent takeaway bars)
- **Slide 01**: Dark cover with title, subtitle, HTTP Archive data source, and time range
- **Slide 02**: Dual-line time-series chart showing desktop (5M→16M) and mobile (3.5M→12.5M) crawl sample growth with mid-2022 jump annotation
- **Slide 03**: Page weight line chart with IQR confidence bands — desktop median ~1,600→~2,000 KB (+25%), 75th pct >4,000 KB
- **Slide 04**: Split layout — left: stat cards for 76/71 requests per page; right: declining TCP connections chart (15→12 desktop, 15→11 mobile)
- **Slide 05**: Large 99%+ stat callout with shield icon, desktop/mobile breakdown (99.2%/99.1%), and small time-series showing ~80%→99% climb
- **Slide 06**: Grouped bar chart (HTTP/2 ~58%, HTTP/3 ~39-40%) + HTTP/3 rise time-series, with measurement caveat note
- **Slide 07**: Font-display adoption trend (40.1% desktop, 42.5% mobile) with 50% majority threshold line
- **Slide 08**: Five key takeaway bullets on dark background with call-to-action

All data points are sourced exclusively from `source_brief.md` — no fabricated figures.
